project.name: oais-structure-manifest
project.description: Reads and writes Representation Information manifests: Turtle excerpts of a Data Object's OAIS Representation Information -- its AND/OR groups, the structure descriptions (DFDL, Kaitai Struct, DRB SDF) that are equivalent alternatives, view specifications and element semantics -- naming every file explicitly, relative to the manifest. Used by the TOPCAT and SPLAT integrations in place of a file-naming convention, and written by archive-manager for its own Data Objects.
